title: Zika Virus Propagation Protocol
author: Elen Mello de Souza
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jkackse
materials: maintain with 5 ml of the Leibovitz L-15 supplemented medium (Cultilab) with 2% fetal bovine serum (Cultilab), 2 mM L-glutamine (Gibco) and 100U/50µg penicillin/streptomycin (Sigma-Aldrich) for seven days at 28°C.

steps.title: Wash Cell Monolayer
steps.instruction: Wash the monolayer of C6/36 lineage cells seeded in the culture flask three times using Phosphate-buffered saline (PBSx1).

steps.title: Inoculate Cells with Virus
steps.instruction: Inoculate the cells with 100 µl of viral suspension at a multiplicity of infection (MOI) of 0.01.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 1h at 37°C to allow for virus adsorption.
Agitate the culture every 15 minutes during incubation.

steps.title: Collect Supernatant
steps.instruction: Collect the supernatant from the infected cultures.

steps.title: Prepare Viral Aliquots
steps.instruction: Create 500 µl aliquots in microtubes containing 20% fetal bovine serum (Cultilab).
